{{Field procedure|summary=Map a planet or moon with Detailed Surface Scanner probes, check both hemispheres, and meet the Probe Efficiency Target when practical.}}

Use this procedure after identifying a planet or moon that is worth mapping. The Detailed Surface Scanner (DSS) maps one body at close range; it does not replace the system discovery and identification scans used earlier in an exploration pass.<ref name="frontier-beyond">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/elite-dangerous-beyond-chapter-four-out-now Elite Dangerous: Beyond – Chapter Four – Out Now], Frontier Developments, 11 December 2018. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

== Before you start ==

* Fit and power a [[Detailed Surface Scanner]].
* Assign '''Surface Scanner''' to a fire group.
* Discover and identify the target body.
* Remain in Supercruise and approach the body.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Target the planet or moon and reduce speed as you approach.
# Switch the ship to '''Analysis Mode'''.
# Activate the Surface Scanner from its assigned fire group when the target is within scanning range.
# Note the '''Probe Efficiency Target''' shown in the DSS interface.
# Fire probes across the visible hemisphere. Spread their impact circles instead of repeatedly covering the same terrain.
# Aim probes just beyond the body's limb to curve their trajectories around to the far side. Use the trajectory indicator to distinguish a near-side hit, a far-side hit, and a miss.
# Switch between the front and back coverage views and place probes across any large unmapped regions.
# Stop when the scan completes. At 90% surface coverage, the DSS fills the remaining gaps and reports the body as fully mapped.<ref name="dss-community">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Detailed_Surface_Scanner Detailed Surface Scanner], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>
}}

DSS probes replenish automatically; they do not consume cargo or require restocking.<ref name="dss-community" />

== Meeting the Probe Efficiency Target ==

The target is the maximum number of probes that can be used while still receiving the mapping-efficiency bonus. A body remains successfully mapped if more probes are used; only the bonus is missed.

To use fewer probes:

* avoid heavy overlap between impact circles;
* place near-side probes around the visible disc rather than clustering them at the centre;
* use the limb indicator to curve probes around the body instead of repositioning the ship; and
* check the back view before firing extra probes.

A larger '''Probe Radius''' covers more surface per impact and makes efficiency targets easier to meet. See [[Detailed Surface Scanner#Engineering|Detailed Surface Scanner § Engineering]] for standard Engineering and special variants.

== Completion check ==

The body should show as '''100% mapped'''. Surface points of interest and applicable signal filters become available after mapping, and the resulting exploration data can be submitted later. A previously unmapped body can receive a permanent First Mapped By tag when the successful scan data is submitted before another Commander's data.

For a body with biological signals, continue with [[How to Choose an Exobiology Search Area with a Detailed Surface Scanner]].

== Common problems ==

* '''The DSS will not activate:''' confirm that the scanner is fitted, powered, assigned to the active fire group, and being used in Analysis Mode while in Supercruise with a valid target.
* '''The target is out of range:''' continue approaching in Supercruise, then reduce speed before opening the scanner again.
* '''Probes keep missing:''' use the trajectory indicator. An aim point too far beyond the limb will miss rather than curve around the body.
* '''The far side remains unmapped:''' switch to the back coverage view and curve probes around the limb.
* '''Small gaps remain:''' the map completes automatically at 90% coverage. Do not chase the final 10% after completion.
* '''The efficiency target was exceeded:''' the scan still counts. Use wider spacing or an increased Probe Radius on the next body.
* '''The body was identified but not mapped:''' system identification and detailed surface mapping are separate actions; open the DSS and complete the probe scan.
